newsitem.title: UK: Edwards raises 3.9 mln stg in Man U sale.
newsitem.headline: Edwards raises 3.9 mln stg in Man U sale.

text.p: Manchester United Plc chief executive Martin Edwards has raised a further 3.9 million stg by selling more shares in the English soccer club, to cut his holding to little more than 14 percent, United said on Thursday.
"Mr Edwards has stated that he has no present intention to dispose of any further shares for the foreseeable future," the club said in a statement.
Edwards has raised almost 10 million stg over the past week as he whittled down his holding from 16.4 to 14.07 percent.
In the latest transactions, Edwards sold 80,000 of his own shares and 500,000 shares held in trust for his children. The price was 680p per share in each deal.
United shares closed 15p higher at 685p on Thursday, valuing the club at around 440 million stg and Edwards' stake at 62 million stg.
